prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished, high fidelity static desktop product UI screenshot for the EXISTING app platformance. Landscape canvas 1536x1100 or similar, large crisp legible text. The supplied workspace-library screenshot is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its exact blue node brand icon and lowercase black platformance wordmark, white slim top bar, Alex Rivera user at top right, cool almost-white background #f8f9fb, centered content max width about 1216px, pale lavender entity header, thin cool gray borders, white rounded 14px cards, Inter typography, violet #7560e3 buttons, lavender selected tabs with violet underline. No dark sidebar, browser chrome, device frame, photorealism, perspective, invented graphs or scores. All UI text ENGLISH. Footer small 'MOCKUP · SAMPLE DATA'. Use consistent fictional data: organization Northstar Studio; workspace Product & Engineering; project Platform team. Exactly two workspace evaluators: Ada (purple round friendly geometric avatar with two white eyes, Direct, Medium effort) and Grace (blue diamond friendly geometric avatar with two white eyes, Balanced, High effort). Exactly two project evaluators: Ada (green rounded-square friendly geometric avatar with two white eyes, Coaching, Medium effort) and Linus (orange friendly geometric avatar, Direct, Low effort). Repeated name Ada is deliberate: scope badges and context names MUST distinguish the two. Scope badges always include BOTH an outline icon and exact text: violet building icon 'Workspace', blue layers icon 'Project'. No automatic running or default execution implied: availability only. Carefully align spacing, fields, badges. SCREEN 1: Workspace administration with a selected existing workspace evaluator. Breadcrumb Organizations > Northstar Studio > Product & Engineering. Lavender header Product & Engineering, description 'Shared context for teams building what comes next.' Tabs Overview, Projects 1, Members, Resources, People, Evaluators 2 (active). Below heading Evaluators, subtitle 'Shared evaluators, available in every project in this workspace.' Right primary '+ New workspace evaluator'. Two-column main area: left 300px white card with heading Workspace evaluators 2, selected Ada purple avatar and Workspace badge, metadata Direct · Medium effort, second Grace blue avatar and Workspace badge, Balanced · High effort. Under list small building icon and Product & Engineering; note 'Available in all projects'. Right larger white editor card heading Ada plus Workspace badge and small 'Product & Engineering' immediately below. Right buttons Save and subtle Delete. Lavender information strip 'Changes apply to all projects in Product & Engineering.' Fields Name (Ada), Description ('A thoughtful look at collaboration.'), Personality with three pills Direct (selected), Balanced, Coaching. Effort slider Minimum / Medium (selected) / Maximum. Section Behavior rules with 2 compact rows: 'Collaboration' and 'Quality of contributions', each weight 5. Section Questions with 'How does the team share ownership?' Small lower collapsed section 'Sources and report structure'. Header, list, detail, footer all visible. Keep clear hierarchy, comfortable whitespace, not a dense settings wall.

revisions.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied existing mockup with ONLY these precise corrections, preserving all other layout, text, names, badges, cards, typography, colors, and read-only state exactly. 1. Remove ALL six-dot drag handles at the left of the two Behavior rules rows AND the Questions row: this is a view-only evaluator and cannot be reordered. Retain their text and weights, align labels naturally. 2. In the entity header replace the purple people symbol with the same pale lavender initials tile 'PT' used in the other project screen, and set its subtitle exactly 'Build the platform, together.' 3. Show Linus's avatar as an orange rounded triangle with two white eyes consistent with the creation example and project screen, preserving orange. No other changes.
